source.author: verg
source.text: Tantos illa suo rumpebat pectore questus.
source.text_original: Tantos illa suo rumpebat pectore questus.
source.text_english: She was breaking forth with such great complaints from her heart.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: an meritos fas est mihi rumpere questus?
reuse.text_original: an meritos fas est mihi rumpere questus?
reuse.text_english: Or is it right for me to break off my deserved complaints?
